选择性可信度有限信念更新Selective Credibility-Limited Belief Update

Theofanis Aravanis1, *     Costas D. Koutras2 
(1数字系统系Department of Digital Systems

taravanis@uop.gr
*通讯作者Corresponding author

摘要Abstract

信念更新涉及由底层世界的变化引起的主体信念的变化。标准 Katsuno-Mendelzon 更新假设可以从每个最初可能的世界合并认知输入，而可信度有限的信念更新则限制每个源世界被视为可信或可达的后继世界。然而，现有的可信度有限的方法将认知输入视为不可分割的整体，因此不能代表只能实现复合认知输入的一部分的情况。我们引入选择性可信度有限信念更新，其中在执行可信度有限转换之前，相对于每个源世界，认知输入被转换为较弱的代理。我们提供更新运算符的结果类的语义和公理特征。然后我们识别出两个表现良好的子类；即，保持一致性的更新算子，它要求只要原始认知输入一致，每个转换后的认知输入就其源世界而言是可信的，以及最大一致性保持更新算子，它还要求所选代理在原始认知输入的可信结果中提供最大程度的信息。最后，我们通过证明可信度限制信念更新作为一种特殊情况被恢复来建立所提出框架的一般性，而当可信度限制被消除并且变换函数被视为恒等式时，Katsuno-Mendelzon 信念更新就会出现。这些结果表明，该框架提供了一个统一的、严格的、更具表现力的信念更新说明，包含既定方法，同时支持依赖于来源的选择性接受。Belief update concerns changes in an agent’s beliefs induced by changes in the underlying world. Standard Katsuno–Mendelzon update assumes that an epistemic input can be incorporated from every initially possible world, whereas credibility-limited belief update restricts, for each source world, the successor worlds regarded as credible or reachable. Nevertheless, existing credibility-limited approaches treat the epistemic input as an indivisible whole, and therefore cannot represent cases in which only part of a compound epistemic input can be realized. We introduce selective credibility-limited belief update, in which the epistemic input is transformed, relative to each source world, into a weaker proxy before the credibility-limited transition is performed. We provide semantic and axiomatic characterizations of the resulting class of update operators. We then identify two well-behaved sub-classes; namely, consistency-preserving update operators, which require every transformed epistemic input to be credible from its source world whenever the original epistemic input is consistent, and maximal consistency-preserving update operators, which additionally require the selected proxy to be maximally informative among the credible consequences of the original epistemic input. Finally, we establish the generality of the proposed framework by showing that credibility-limited belief update is recovered as a special case, while Katsuno–Mendelzon belief update emerges when credibility restrictions are removed and the transformation functions are taken to be identities. These results demonstrate that the framework provides a unified and strictly more expressive account of belief update, encompassing established approaches while supporting source-dependent selective acceptance.

关键词：Keywords:信念更新、非优先信念改变、选择性接受、可信度有限的信念更新、知识表示和推理Belief Update, Non-Prioritized Belief Change, Selective Acceptance, Credibility-Limited Belief Update, Knowledge Representation and Reasoning

1 简介Introduction

信念改变涉及代理人对新信息的反应而理性地改变信念Belief change concerns the rational modification of an agent’s beliefs in response to new information[11]。通常存在以下基本区别：. A fundamental distinction is commonly drawn between信念修正belief revision，当新信息纠正了代理对固定世界的描述时，这是合适的, which is appropriate when the new information corrects the agent’s description of a fixed world[1, 14], 和, and信念更新belief update，当信息报告世界本身发生变化时，这是适当的。凯勒和温斯莱特以早期形式引入了信仰更新, which is appropriate when the information reports a change in the world itself. Belief update was introduced in an early form by Keller and Winslett[18]随后由 Katsuno 和 Mendelzon 给出了标准的公理和语义表征and was subsequently given its standard axiomatic and semantic characterization by Katsuno and Mendelzon[17]。在 Katsuno-Mendelzon (KM) 框架中，与智能体先前信念兼容的每个可能世界（或简称世界）都被视为可能的初始状态，并配备了潜在后继世界的排序。通过认知输入进行更新相当于从每个初始世界中选择满足该认知输入的最合理的后继世界。. In the Katsuno–Mendelzon (KM) framework, each possible world (or simply world) compatible with the agent’s prior beliefs is treated as a possible initial state, and is equipped with an ordering of potential successor worlds. Updating by an epistemic input then amounts to selecting, from each initial world, the most plausible successor worlds satisfying that epistemic input.

标准 KM 信念更新是Standard KM belief update is a优先的prioritized信念的形式发生变化，因为认知输入需要被纳入最终的信念状态中。这种无条件的成功要求反映了这样的假设：所报告的变化已经发生，因此必须予以适应，即使这样做需要与代理人之前的信念有很大的背离。然而，在许多应用中，认知输入可能描述物理上不可能的、因果上不可接受的、不可靠的或以其他方式无法从一些被认为最初可能的世界实现的转变。在这种情况下，无条件优先权要求太高。form of belief change, as the epistemic input is required to be incorporated into the resulting state of belief. This unconditional success requirement reflects the assumption that the reported change has occurred and must therefore be accommodated, even when doing so requires departing substantially from the agent’s previous beliefs. In many applications, however, an epistemic input may describe a transition that is physically impossible, causally inadmissible, unreliable, or otherwise unrealizable from some of the worlds regarded as initially possible. In such cases, unconditional priority is too demanding.

非优先级Non-prioritized信念改变放宽了成功要求，允许认知输入在不满足相关可接受条件时被拒绝或仅部分接受belief change relaxes the success requirement by allowing an epistemic input to be rejected or only partially accepted when it fails to meet the relevant admissibility conditions[8]。由此产生的更改操作不需要完整地接受每个认知输入；相反，接受度可能取决于可信度、一致性、可靠性或可达性等因素。在更新设置中，这种依赖自然是存在的. The resulting change operation is not required to accept every epistemic input in its entirety; instead, acceptance may depend on factors such as credibility, consistency, reliability, or reachability. In the update setting, this dependence is naturally源相关的source-relative，因为认知输入可以从一个最初可能的世界实现，但不能从另一个世界实现。因此，一个合理的非优先更新机制必须确定，对于每个源世界，所报告的转换是否可以被接受，以及当不可能完全接受时应如何处理相应的分支。, because an epistemic input may be realizable from one initially possible world but not from another. Therefore, a rational non-prioritized update mechanism must determine, for each source world, whether the reported transition can be accepted and how the corresponding branch should be treated when complete acceptance is not possible.

的The可信度有限credibility-limitedFermé 的信念更新框架belief-update framework of Fermé等人。et al.通过将每个源世界与一组有限的可信或可到达的后继者相关联，将源相对可信度限制引入信念更新中introduces source-relative credibility restrictions into belief update, by associating each source world with a restricted set of credible or reachable successors[12]。只能选择认知输入的可信世界。在可信度限制（CL）方法下，当认知输入相对于源世界没有可信世界时，源分支不会贡献后继者；因此，无条件成功得以保留，但一致性可能会失败。当认知输入无法可信地实现时，一致可信度限制（CCL）信念更新采用保留源世界的补充策略。这保持了一致性，但允许局部拒绝认知输入。因此，尽管只有 CCL 允许局部拒绝认知输入，但这两种机制都偏离了标准 KM 信念更新，使每个源分支的处理依赖于源相对可信度。. Only credible worlds of the epistemic input may be selected. Under the credibility-limited (CL) approach, a source branch contributes no successor when the epistemic input has no credible world, relative to that source world; consequently, unconditional success is retained, but consistency may fail. Consistent credibility-limited (CCL) belief update adopts the complementary policy of retaining the source world whenever the epistemic input cannot be credibly realized. This preserves consistency, but permits the epistemic input to be locally rejected. Thus, both mechanisms depart from standard KM belief update by making the treatment of each source branch dependent on source-relative credibility, although only CCL permits local rejection of the epistemic input.

尽管这些方法提供了对可信度敏感的偏离标准知识管理信念更新的方法，但它们仍然将认知输入视为Although these approaches provide credibility-sensitive departures from standard KM belief update, they continue to treat the epistemic input as an不可分割的整体indivisible whole。相对于每个源世界，完整的认知输入要么被实现，要么被拒绝，要么通过消除相应的分支而变得无效。当认知输入表达复合变化且其组成部分不需要同样可实现时，这种全有或全无的处理是有限制性的。例如，假设机器人被指示将杯子移到桌子上并装满它。如果杯子完好无损，则指令的两个部分都可以执行。然而，如果杯子破裂了，机器人仍然可以移动它，但无法装满它。在这样的现实场景中，标准 KM 信念更新可以通过选择物理上不可能的后继者来表示完整指令是成功的。可信度有限的信念更新可能会消除破碎的杯子分支，而其一致的变体可能会完全拒绝指令并将杯子留在其原始位置。这些结果都不代表. Relative to each source world, the complete epistemic input is either realized, rejected, or rendered ineffective through the elimination of the corresponding branch. This all-or-nothing treatment is restrictive when the epistemic input expresses a compound change whose components need not be equally realizable. For example, suppose that a robot is instructed to move a cup to a table and fill it. If the cup is intact, both parts of the instruction may be executable. If the cup is broken, however, the robot may still be able to move it, while being unable to fill it. In such a real-world scenario, standard KM belief update may represent the complete instruction as successful by selecting a physically impossible successor. Credibility-limited belief update may instead eliminate the broken-cup branch, while its consistent variant may reject the instruction altogether and leave the cup in its original position. None of these outcomes represents the中间情况intermediate case其中仅实现了复合指令的可执行部分。in which only the executable part of the compound instruction is realized.

本篇文章介绍The present article introduces选择性可信度有限信念更新selective credibility-limited belief update，缩写为, abbreviated asSCL信念更新SCL belief update，作为一种更灵活的非优先信念更新形式。该框架建立在三个主要研究方向之上；即KM信念更新的逐点语义, as a more flexible form of non-prioritized belief update. The framework builds on three principal lines of research; namely, the pointwise semantics of KM belief update[17]，Fermé 的可信度有限信念更新模型, the credibility-limited belief-update models of Fermé等人。et al. [12]，以及为选择性信念修正而开发的基于转换的方法, and the transformation-based methodology developed for selective belief revision[10, 13]。 SCL 信念更新不需要在完全接受和完全拒绝之间进行与源相关的选择，而是允许将认知输入转化为. Rather than requiring a source-relative choice between complete acceptance and complete rejection, SCL belief update permits the epistemic input to be transformed into a较弱的代理weaker proxy在应用过渡机制之前。因此，接受不仅在源世界之间存在差异，而且在程度上也存在差异，因为相同的认知输入可能会从一个源世界完全接受，而从另一个源世界有选择地削弱。这使得可以表示复合认知输入的部分实现，而无需承认不可信的后继世界、消除相应的源分支或使该分支完全不变。before the transition mechanism is applied. As a consequence, acceptance can vary not only between source worlds, but also in extent, as the same epistemic input may be fully accepted from one source world and selectively weakened from another. This makes it possible to represent the partial realization of compound epistemic inputs without either admitting non-credible successor worlds, eliminating the corresponding source branch, or leaving that branch entirely unchanged.

本文的贡献既是基础性的又是比较性的。首先，我们根据可信的忠实赋值提供 SCL 更新运算符的语义和公理特征The contributions of the article are both foundational and comparative. First, we provide semantic and axiomatic characterizations of SCL update operators, in terms of credible faithful assignments[12]和依赖于源的变换函数and source-dependent transformation functions[10]。其次，我们确定了两个逐渐受到更多限制的子类。. Second, we identify two progressively more constrained sub-classes.保持一致性Consistency-preservingSCL更新算子要求只要原始认知输入一致，转换后的认知输入就其相应的源世界而言是可信的，从而确保在这种情况下每个最初可能的世界至少贡献一个后继者。SCL update operators require the transformed epistemic input to be credible from its corresponding source world whenever the original epistemic input is consistent, thus ensuring that every initially possible world contributes at least one successor in such cases.最大程度保持一致性Maximal consistency-preservingSCL 更新算子还要求，对于每个一致的认知输入，所选代理在其可信结果中包含最多的信息。第三，我们分离出一个不受限制的可信度变体，它捕获选择性信念更新SCL update operators additionally require, for every consistent epistemic input, the selected proxy to be maximally informative among its credible consequences. Third, we isolate an unrestricted-credibility variant that captures selective belief update独立地independently的可信度限制。最后，我们将已建立的 KM、CL 和 CCL 方法定位在所提出的框架内；因此，CL信念更新通过身份转换来恢复，CCL信念更新通过在认知输入局部不可信时保留源世界的转换来恢复，KM信念更新通过另外消除可信度限制来更新。我们进一步确定这些类别之间的主要包含关系是正确的，表明 SCL 信念更新构成了of credibility limitations. Finally, we locate the established KM, CL, and CCL approaches within the proposed framework; accordingly, CL belief update is recovered by means of identity transformations, CCL belief update by transformations that retain the source world whenever the epistemic input is not locally credible, and KM belief update by additionally removing credibility restrictions. We further establish that the principal inclusion relations among these classes are proper, showing that SCL belief update constitutes a更严格地表达strictly more expressive框架而不是它所包含的方法。framework than the approaches it subsumes.

2 相关工作Related Work

所提出的框架位于信念改变和复合信息的部分实现的多个研究领域的交叉点。本节将 SCL 信念更新与现有的非优先信念改变方法联系起来，并澄清其与它们的不同之处。The proposed framework lies at the intersection of several lines of research on belief change and the partial realization of compound information. This section situates SCL belief update in relation to existing non-prioritized approaches to belief change and clarifies the respects in which it differs from them.

对非优先信念改变的研究主要集中在信念修正上，从而产生了一些模型，在这些模型中，传入的信息可能被拒绝、部分接受或根据不同的可信度水平进行评估；请参阅 Fermé、Garapa 和 Reis 最近的调查Research on non-prioritized belief change has concentrated primarily on belief revision, giving rise to models in which incoming information may be rejected, partially accepted, or assessed according to different levels of credibility; see the recent survey by Fermé, Garapa, and Reis[8]。在这些模型中，. Among these models,选择性修改selective revision与目前的工作特别相关，因为它允许认知输入被代表代理准备接受的信息部分的较弱代理替换is particularly relevant to the present work, since it allows an epistemic input to be replaced by a weaker proxy representing the part of the information that the agent is prepared to accept[10, 13]。尽管最近在知识管理框架内或与知识管理框架密切相关，开发了两种不同的方法，但非优先信念更新受到的关注相对较少。首先，格里马尔迪、马丁内斯和罗德里格斯介绍. Non-prioritized belief update has received comparatively less attention, although two distinct approaches have recently been developed within, or in close connection with, the KM framework. First, Grimaldi, Martinez, and Rodriguez introduce本地推广local promotion，信仰提升的更新版本, an update counterpart of belief promotion[22]，其中新信息不需要获得无条件优先级, in which the new information need not receive unconditional priority[15]。局部提升通过两个底层更新算子和一个触发函数来表示，触发函数确定可以相对于认知输入保留先验信息的哪一部分。因此，它的主要关注点是当先前状态和认知输入相结合时旧信息的受控保存。二、Fermé的可信度有限信念更新框架. Local promotion is represented through two underlying update operators and a trigger function that determines which part of the prior information may be preserved relative to the epistemic input. Therefore, its principal concern is the controlled preservation of old information when the prior state and the epistemic input are combined. Second, the credibility-limited belief-update framework of Fermé等人。et al.将每个源世界与一组有限的可信或可到达的后继世界关联起来associates each source world with a restricted set of credible or reachable successor worlds[12]。在这种方法下，源相对可信度决定了完整的认知输入是否具有可接受的实现：当不存在这种实现时，CL 消除源分支，而 CCL 保留源世界，从而允许局部拒绝认知输入。. Under this approach, source-relative credibility determines whether the complete epistemic input has an admissible realization: CL eliminates a source branch when no such realization exists, whereas CCL retains the source world and thereby permits local rejection of the epistemic input.

复合认知输入的相关但概念上不同的处理由A related, but conceptually different, treatment of compound epistemic inputs is provided by the成分信念更新compositional belief update德尔格朗德、金和佩尔蒂埃of Delgrande, Jin, and Pelletier[6]。它们的运算符递归地分解更新公式的语法结构，并组合从其组成子公式获得的结果。因此，组合信念更新使得复合认知输入的内部结构在操作上具有重要意义，并支持相对直接的实现。然而，它保留了完整认知输入的成功，并且在其一般形式下，不满足全套标准知识管理假设，包括逻辑等效更新公式替换下的不变性。因此，它的目的不同于选择性接受——它决定了复合认知输入如何从其句法构成中实现，而不是是否只接受该认知输入中较弱的部分。. Their operator recursively decomposes the syntactic structure of the update formula and combines the results obtained from its constituent sub-formulae. Hence, compositional belief update makes the internal structure of a compound epistemic input operationally significant and supports comparatively direct implementations. Nevertheless, it retains success for the complete epistemic input and, in its general form, does not satisfy the full set of standard KM postulates, including invariance under the substitution of logically equivalent update formulae. Therefore, its purpose is different from selective acceptance — it determines how a compound epistemic input is realized from its syntactic composition, rather than whether only a weaker part of that epistemic input should be accepted.

本文通过结合可信度有限信念更新的逐点可信度限制来解决一个独特的问题The present article addresses a distinct problem by combining the pointwise credibility restrictions of credibility-limited belief update[12]，采用基于转换的选择性修订方法, with the transformation-based methodology of selective revision[10]。在SCL信念更新中，在执行可信的后继选择之前，在每个源世界中认知输入在语义上被独立地削弱。与本地提升不同，SCL信念更新不会通过结合与先前状态和新信息相关的单独贡献来获得非优先级；相反，它直接将认知输入转换为源相关代理。与组合信念更新不同，变换在逻辑等价下是不变的，并且与认知输入的句法分解无关。因此，SCL 信念更新不仅可以表示某个认知输入是否被给定的源世界接受，还可以表示该输入在该源世界被接受的程度，同时排除不可信的后继世界。这个想法还与部分满意规划具有概念上的亲和力，其中代理在无法实现整套目标时寻求有价值的解决方案，包括最近对分层任务网络规划的扩展. In SCL belief update, the epistemic input is weakened semantically and independently at each source world before credible successor selection is performed. Unlike local promotion, SCL belief update does not obtain non-prioritization by combining separate contributions associated with the prior state and the new information; instead, it directly transforms the epistemic input into a source-relative proxy. Unlike compositional belief update, the transformation is invariant under logical equivalence and is not tied to the syntactic decomposition of the epistemic input. Consequently, SCL belief update can represent not only whether an epistemic input is accepted from a given source world, but also the extent to which it is accepted there, while excluding non-credible successor worlds. This idea also bears a conceptual affinity to partial-satisfaction planning, where an agent seeks valuable solutions when the complete set of objectives cannot be achieved, including recent extensions to hierarchical task-network planning[3]。不同之处在于，SCL 信念更新在认知层面进行操作，选择相对于每个源世界的认知输入的可信逻辑结果，而不是对规划目标的子集进行优化。. The difference is that SCL belief update operates at the epistemic level, selecting a credible logical consequence of the epistemic input relative to each source world, rather than optimizing over subsets of planning objectives.

4 信念更新Belief Update

信念更新的目的是当新信息报告底层世界的演变时，对智能体信念的变化进行建模，而不是像信念修正那样，表明智能体之前对不变世界的描述是错误的。这种信仰改变形式的早期基础是由凯勒和温斯莱特建立的Belief update is intended to model changes in an agent’s beliefs when the new information reports an evolution of the underlying world, rather than, as in belief revision, indicating that the agent’s previous description of an unchanged world was mistaken. Early foundations of this form of belief change were developed by Keller and Winslett[18]，而其标准正式处理随后由 Katsuno 和 Mendelzon 提供, while its standard formal treatment was subsequently provided by Katsuno and Mendelzon[17]。在本节中，我们简要回顾一下 Katsuno-Mendelzon (KM) 信念更新的公理化表征及其相应的语义表示。. In this section, we briefly recall the axiomatic characterization of Katsuno–Mendelzon (KM) belief update and its corresponding semantic representation.

每个假设的作用可总结如下。假设The role of each postulate may be summarized as follows. Postulate(K⋄1)(K\diamond 1)确保每个更新结果在逻辑结果下都是关闭的，并且ensures that every update result is closed under logical consequence, and(K⋄2)(K\diamond 2)通过要求认知输入被完全接受来强加成功。假设imposes success by requiring the epistemic input to be fully accepted. Finally,(K⋄9)(K\diamond 9)通过要求一致理论的更新由与其兼容的完整世界的更新来确定，捕获了信念更新的独特逐点性质。captures the distinctive pointwise nature of belief update, by requiring the update of a consistent theory to be determined by the updates of the complete worlds compatible with it.

5.2 覆铜板方法The CCL Approach

CCL信念更新对局部不可信的认知输入采取不同的策略。它没有消除源分支，而是保持相应的源世界不变。这恢复了一致性，但需要用较弱的、相对于源的接受原则来取代无条件成功。CCL belief update adopts a different policy for locally non-credible epistemic inputs. Rather than eliminating a source branch, it leaves the corresponding source world unchanged. This restores consistency, but requires unconditional success to be replaced by a weaker, source-relative acceptance principle.

（红外）(IR) If φ\varphi不一致，那么is inconsistent, thenK⋄φ=KK\diamond\varphi=K.

Postulate (SM), success monotonicity, ensures that whenever an epistemic input is successfully accepted, its logical consequences are successfully accepted as well. Finally, postulate (IR) requires every inconsistent epistemic input to be rejected.222假设（IR）在 CCL 信念更新的公理化中没有明确说明Postulate (IR) is not stated explicitly in the axiomatization of CCL belief update presented in[12]。然而，相应表示定理的证明隐含地将注意力限制在一致的认知输入上。我们在此包含（IR）以获得任意认知输入的所述特征。. 6 选择性接受可信度有限的信念更新Selective Acceptance in Credibility-Limited Belief Update

在回顾了标准知识管理信念更新及其可信度有限的概括之后，我们现在介绍Having reviewed standard KM belief update and its credibility-limited generalizations, we now introduce选择性接受selective acceptance进入更新设置。如图所示，Fermé 现有的可信度有限的方法into the update setting. As shown, the existing credibility-limited approach by Fermé等人。et al. [12]继续将认知输入视为不可分割的整体：相对于源世界，它要么被完全实现，要么通过保留源世界而局部拒绝，要么通过消除源分支而变得无效。这种全有或全无的处理方法对于复合认知输入来说是不够的，因为复合认知输入的组成部分可能在可信度或可执行性方面有所不同。continue to treat the epistemic input as an indivisible whole: relative to a source world, it is either fully realized, locally rejected by retaining the source world, or rendered ineffective by eliminating the source branch. This all-or-nothing treatment is inadequate for compound epistemic inputs whose components may differ in their credibility or executability.

基本思想是在应用潜在的信念改变机制之前插入一个转换阶段。在这方面，所提出的结构是信念更新的类似物The basic idea is to interpose a transformation stage before the underlying belief-change mechanism is applied. In this respect, the proposed construction is the belief-update analogue of选择性信念修正selective belief revision [10]，其中认知输入在由修订算子处理之前被转换为可接受的代理。然而，在更新设置中，KM 语义的逐点特征要求相对于每个源可能世界来确定认知输入的接受部分。下面将阐述这个想法的语义实现。, in which an epistemic input is transformed into an acceptable proxy before being processed by a revision operator. In the update setting, however, the pointwise character of the KM semantics requires the accepted portion of the epistemic input to be determined relative to each source possible world. The semantic realization of this idea is developed below.

6.1 语义表征Semantic Characterization

选择性接受是通过在执行可信度限制转换之前转换认知输入来表示的。因此，我们将每个源世界关联起来Selective acceptance is represented by transforming the epistemic input before the credibility-limited transition is performed. Accordingly, we associate each source worldww与一个with a变换函数transformation function fwf_{w}。给定认知输入. Given an epistemic inputφ\varphi，公式, the formulafw​(φ)f_{w}(\varphi)代表的一部分represents the part ofφ\varphi这是接受自that is accepted fromww。然后将转换机制应用于这种转换后的认知输入，而不是直接应用于. The transition mechanism is then applied to this transformed epistemic input rather than directly toφ\varphi。这种源依赖性保留了知识管理信念更新的逐点语义，同时允许不同源世界的接受程度有所不同。因此，相同的认知输入可能会从一个源世界被完全接受，而从另一个源世界被削弱。源相关转换的集合通过以下分配形式化。. This source dependence preserves the pointwise semantics of KM belief update, while allowing the extent of acceptance to vary across source worlds. Thus, the same epistemic input may be fully accepted from one source world, and weakened from another. The collection of source-dependent transformations is formalized by the following assignment.

定义13Definition 13 （逐点变换作业）(Pointwise Transformation Assignment).

逐点变换作业是一个族A pointwise transformation assignment is a familyℱ={fw:w∈𝕄}\mathcal{F}=\left\{f_{w}:w\in\mathbb{M}\right\}，其中每个, where everyfw:ℒ↦ℒf_{w}:\mathcal{L}\mapsto\mathcal{L}是一个变换函数。is a transformation function.

To capture this interpretation, a pointwise transformation assignment may satisfy the following basic properties.

(F1) φ⊧fw​(φ)\varphi\models f_{w}(\varphi).
(F2) If φ≡ψ\varphi\equiv\psi，那么, thenfw​(φ)≡fw​(ψ)f_{w}(\varphi)\equiv f_{w}(\psi).
(F3) fw​(fw​(φ))≡fw​(φ)f_{w}\big(f_{w}(\varphi)\big)\equiv f_{w}(\varphi).

属性 (F1)–(F3) 是根据选择性信念修正中变换函数的相应条件改编的Properties (F1)–(F3) are adapted from corresponding conditions on transformation functions in selective belief revision[10, p. 335]。更具体地说，它们是依赖于源的对应物. More specifically, they are the source-dependent counterparts of暗示implication, 外延性extensionality, 和, and幂等性idempotence，分别。属性（F1）允许转换丢弃信息，但阻止它引入原始认知输入未暗示的信息。属性 (F2) 保证转换对语法表示不敏感，而属性 (F3) 要求所选代理是转换的固定点。, respectively. Property (F1) permits the transformation to discard information, but prevents it from introducing information not implied by the original epistemic input. Property (F2) guarantees that the transformation is insensitive to syntactic representation, while property (F3) requires the selected proxy to be a fixed point of the transformation.

属性（F4）可以被视为与源相关的可信度对应物Property (F4) may be viewed as the source-relative credibility counterpart of弱极大性weak maximality选择性信念修正in selective belief revision[10, p. 335]。在那里，弱极大性要求认知输入在与先验信念集一致时保持不变。在这里，与先验信念集的一致性被局部可信度所取代. There, weak maximality requires the epistemic input to be retained unchanged whenever it is consistent with the prior belief set. Consequently, SCL belief update represents the partial realization of the compound postcondition.333这一部分实现的结果也澄清了 SCL 信念更新和本地推广之间的区别This partially realized outcome also clarifies the distinction between SCL belief update and both local promotion[15]和成分信念更新and compositional belief update[6]。局部提升调节在处理新信息时可以保留多少先验信息，而组合信念更新则利用认知输入的句法结构来确定如何实现认知输入。然而，在他们的标准表述中，这两种方法都没有将认知输入转换为相对于特定源世界而言较弱的代理，从该源世界无法实现完整的转变。因此，两者都没有直接代表中间结果，其中仅影响复合认知输入的可实现部分。. Local promotion regulates how much of the prior information may be preserved while the new information is processed, whereas compositional belief update exploits the syntactic structure of the epistemic input in order to determine how that epistemic input is realized. In their standard formulations, however, neither approach transforms the epistemic input into a weaker proxy relative to the particular source world from which the complete transition is unrealizable. Consequently, neither directly represents the intermediate outcome in which only the realizable part of the compound epistemic input is effected.

6.3 不受限制的可信度变体：选择性信念更新An Unrestricted-Credibility Variant: Selective Belief Update

SCL 框架结合了两种概念上不同的机制；即，确定接受认知输入的哪一部分的依赖于源的转换，以及限制每个源世界可用的后继世界的可信度限制。为了隔离前一种机制，我们现在The SCL framework combines two conceptually distinct mechanisms; i.e., a source-dependent transformation that determines which part of the epistemic input is accepted, and a credibility restriction that limits the successor worlds available from each source world. To isolate the former mechanism, we now消除可信度限制remove the credibility restrictions将每个可信集合视为整个世界集合by taking every credible set to be the entire set of worlds𝕄\mathbb{M}。在这种不受限制的环境中，属性（F1）-（F3）保留了选择性转换的基本结构要求，而属性（F4）被故意省略，因为它会迫使每个一致的认知输入被接受不变。. In this unrestricted setting, properties (F1)–(F3) retain the essential structural requirements on selective transformations, whereas property (F4) is deliberately omitted, since it would force every consistent epistemic input to be accepted unchanged.444确实，如果Indeed, ifCw=𝕄C_{w}=\mathbb{M}和andφ\varphi是一致的，那么is consistent, then[φ]∩Cw=[φ]≠∅[\varphi]\cap C_{w}=[\varphi]\neq\varnothing;因此，财产; hence, property(F4){\rm(F4)}需要entailsfw​(φ)≡φf_{w}(\varphi)\equiv\varphi.因此，由此产生的框架捕获了独立于可信度限制的选择性信念更新。Therefore, the resulting framework captures selective belief update independently of credibility limitation.

8 KM、CL 和 CCL 信念更新作为 SCL 信念更新的特例KM, CL, and CCL Belief Update as Special Cases of SCL Belief Update

介绍了 SCL 框架并描述了其主要子类的特征后，我们现在检查它与标准 KM 信念更新的关系Having introduced the SCL framework and characterized its principal sub-classes, we now examine its relationship with standard KM belief update[17]以及可信度有限的方法and the credibility-limited approaches of费尔梅Fermé等人。et al. [12]。我们表明，CL 和 CCL 信念更新是通过点变换分配的特定选择作为 SCL 信念更新的特殊情况而出现的，而 KM 信念更新是通过另外消除可信度限制来恢复的。这些结果表明 SCL 框架. We show that CL and CCL belief update arise as special cases of SCL belief update through particular choices of the pointwise transformation assignment, while KM belief update is recovered by additionally removing the credibility restrictions. These results establish that the SCL framework包含所有三种方法subsumes all three approaches.

8.2 SCL 层次结构中的知识管理信念更新KM Belief Update within the SCL Hierarchy

Since expansion may produce an inconsistent result from a consistent prior belief set and a consistent epistemic input, it is not a consistency-preserving SCL update operator. Hence, the class of KM update operators is a proper sub-class of the class of CL update operators, while the class of consistency-preserving SCL update operators is a proper sub-class of the class of SCL update operators.

9 结论Conclusion

本文介绍了选择性可信度有限的信念更新，这是一个建立在三个主要研究方向上的非优先框架；即 Katsuno-Mendelzon (KM) 信念更新的逐点语义This article introduced selective credibility-limited belief update, a non-prioritized framework that builds on three principal lines of research; namely, the pointwise semantics of Katsuno–Mendelzon (KM) belief update[17]，可信度有限（CL）和一致可信度有限（CCL）信念更新模型, the credibility-limited (CL) and consistent credibility-limited (CCL) belief-update models of费尔梅Fermé等人。et al. [12]，以及为选择性信念修正而开发的基于转变的方法, and the transformation-based approach developed for selective belief revision[10]。所提出的框架通过将依赖于源的转换函数集成到可信度有限的转换结构中来结合这些想法。对于每个最初可能的世界，认知输入首先被代表可以从该源世界接受的信息的较弱代理替代；然后选择所产生的代理中最可信的世界作为可能的继承者。这种两阶段的构造保留了知识管理信念更新的逐点特征，同时克服了现有可信度有限方法中对复合认知输入的全有或全无处理. The proposed framework combines these ideas by integrating source-dependent transformation functions into credibility-limited transition structures. For each initially possible world, the epistemic input is first replaced by a weaker proxy representing the information that can be accepted from that source world; the most plausible credible worlds of the resulting proxy are then selected as possible successors. This two-stage construction preserves the pointwise character of KM belief update, while overcoming the all-or-nothing treatment of compound epistemic inputs found in existing credibility-limited approaches[12].

我们提供了选择性可信度限制（SCL）更新算子的结果类别的语义和公理特征。我们还确定了两个逐渐受到更多限制的子类。保持一致性的 SCL 更新算子要求每个转换后的认知输入在原始认知输入一致时都具有相对于其源世界的可信世界，从而确保在这种情况下每个最初可能的世界至少贡献一个后继者。最大程度保持一致性的 SCL 更新算子还要求，对于每个一致的认知输入，所选代理在其可信结果中包含最多的信息。相应的表示结果阐明了施加于源相关变换的语义属性与诱导更新算子的可观察合理性属性之间的关系。We provided both semantic and axiomatic characterizations of the resulting class of selective credibility-limited (SCL) update operators. We also identified two progressively more constrained sub-classes. Consistency-preserving SCL update operators require every transformed epistemic input to have a credible world relative to its source world whenever the original epistemic input is consistent, thus ensuring that every initially possible world contributes at least one successor in such cases. Maximal consistency-preserving SCL update operators additionally require, for every consistent epistemic input, the selected proxy to be maximally informative among its credible consequences. The corresponding representation results clarify the relationship between the semantic properties imposed on source-dependent transformations and the observable rationality properties of the induced update operators.

SCL 框架还为其起源的既定方法提供了统一的视角。 CL 信念更新是通过将所有依赖于源的变换函数视为恒等式来恢复的，而 CCL 信念更新是通过用保留相应源世界的代理替换局部不可信的认知输入来获得的。标准 KM 信念更新是通过另外删除可信度限制来恢复的。此外，纳入结果表明本文考虑的主要类别通过适当的遏制相关。因此，选择性可信度有限的信念更新提供了一个比它所包含的既定方法更严格的表达框架，因为它支持依赖于源的部分接受，而不需要消除或不变地保留无法实现完整认知输入的源分支。The SCL framework also provides a unified perspective on the established approaches from which it originates. CL belief update is recovered by taking all source-dependent transformation functions to be identities, whereas CCL belief update is obtained by replacing locally non-credible epistemic inputs with proxies that retain the corresponding source worlds. Standard KM belief update is recovered by additionally removing the credibility restrictions. Moreover, the inclusion results establish that the principal classes considered herein are related by proper containment. Therefore, selective credibility-limited belief update provides a strictly more expressive framework than the established approaches it encompasses, as it supports source-dependent partial acceptance, without requiring the elimination or unchanged retention of source branches from which the complete epistemic input cannot be realized.

拟议的框架提出了未来工作的几个方向。首先，进一步的研究可以解决框架的更宽松的变体，包括仅基于属性（F1）–（F3）的选择性信念更新，如小节中所述Several directions for future work arise from the proposed framework. First, further study could address more relaxed variants of the framework, including selective belief update based only on properties (F1)–(F3), as specified in Subsection6.3，以及通过削弱全套要求（F1）–（F4）获得的中间设置。还可以利用选择性置信修正中变换函数研究的条件，研究逐点变换分配的其他属性, as well as intermediate settings obtained by weakening the full set of requirements (F1)–(F4). Additional properties of pointwise transformation assignments could also be investigated, drawing on the conditions studied for transformation functions in selective belief revision[10, p. 335]。特别是，单调性、否定条件、合取和析取分布以及析取因式分解的源相关对应物可能会产生额外的行为良好的 SCL 更新运算符类别和相应的公理特征。相关问题涉及可接受代理的存在性和唯一性，以及确定它们和计算结果更新的计算复杂性。进一步的工作还可能解决迭代信念更新问题. In particular, source-relative counterparts of monotonicity, negation conditions, conjunctive and disjunctive distribution, and disjunctive factoring may yield additional well-behaved classes of SCL update operators and corresponding axiomatic characterizations. Related questions concern the existence and uniqueness of admissible proxies, as well as the computational complexity of determining them and computing the resulting updates. Further work may also address iterated belief update[9, 7]，以及更丰富的逻辑设置的扩展, and extensions to richer logical settings[21]、多代理设置, multi-agent settings[24, 19]和基于行动的形式主义, and action-based formalisms[5, 23].
